```mql5
input double  ZExit      = 0.3;
input double  ZHardSL    = 3.5;
input double  CorrMin    = -0.7;
input int     CorrPeriod = 30;
input int     MaxHoldD   = 5;

input group "═══ LOT MODE ═══"
// Pair Trading ใช้ Fixed Lot เป็นหลัก เพราะต้องสมดุลทั้งสองฝั่ง
input bool   Lot_Dynamic    = false;  // Dynamic จะปรับ Lot ตาม Balance
input double Lot_RiskPct    = 0.5;   // Dynamic: Risk % ต่อ Pair
input double Lot_Fixed      = 0.01;  // Fixed: Lot คงที่ทั้งสองฝั่ง
input bool   Lot_UseEquity  = false;
input double Lot_Min        = 0.01;
input double Lot_Max        = 1.0;

input group "═══ Money Management ═══"
input double MaxDD_Pct      = 8.0;
input double MaxDay_Pct     = 2.0;
input int    MaxPos         = 2;

input int Magic = 111098104;

//────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
double CalcLot()
{
   double ls = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP);
   double mn = MathMax(Lot_Min, SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN));
   double mx = MathMin(Lot_Max, SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX));
   if(!Lot_Dynamic)
   {
      double lot = MathFloor(Lot_Fixed / ls) * ls;
      return MathMax(mn, MathMin(mx, lot));
   }
   // Dynamic: คำนวณจาก Risk% แต่ Pair Trade ใช้ ATR น้อยมาก
   // ใช้ % ของ Balance หารด้วย 100 เป็น Base
   double base = Lot_UseEquity ? AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY)
                               : AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
   double lot = base * Lot_RiskPct / 100.0 / 1000.0;
   lot = MathFloor(lot / ls) * ls;
   return MathMax(mn, MathMin(mx, lot));
}

bool DDHit(){double b=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),e=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);return b>0&&(b-e)/b*100.0>=MaxDD_Pct;}
bool DayHit(){double b=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),lim=b*MaxDay_Pct/100.0;datetime d0=StringToTime(TimeToString(TimeCurrent(),TIME_DATE));double pl=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;pl+=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)+PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);}HistorySelect(d0,TimeCurrent());for(int i=0;i<HistoryDealsTotal();i++){ulong d=HistoryDealGetTicket(i);if((int)HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;if(HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_ENTRY)==DEAL_ENTRY_OUT)pl+=HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_PROFIT)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_SWAP)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_COMMISSION);}return pl<=-lim;}
void CloseAll(){for(int i=PositionsTotal()-1;i>=0;i--){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)trade.PositionClose(t);}}
int CntPos(){int n=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)n++;}return n;}

double ZScore()
{
   double c1[], c2[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(c1, true); ArraySetAsSeries(c2, true);
   if(CopyClose(_Symbol, TF_Main, 0, Lookback+1, c1) < Lookback+1) return EMPTY_VALUE;
   if(CopyClose(Symbol2, TF_Main, 0, Lookback+1, c2) < Lookback+1) return EMPTY_VALUE;
   double sp[]; ArrayResize(sp, Lookback);
   for(int i = 0; i < Lookback; i++) sp[i] = c1[i] - (1.0 - c2[i]);
   double mn = 0, sd = 0;
   for(int i = 0; i < Lookback; i++) mn += sp[i]; mn /= Lookback;
   for(int i = 0; i < Lookback; i++) sd += MathPow(sp[i]-mn, 2); sd = MathSqrt(sd/Lookback);
   return sd == 0 ? 0 : (sp[0] - mn) / sd;
}

double Corr()
{
   double c1[], c2[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(c1, true); ArraySetAsSeries(c2, true);
   CopyClose(_Symbol, TF_Main, 0, CorrPeriod, c1);
   CopyClose(Symbol2, TF_Main, 0, CorrPeriod, c2);
   double m1=0, m2=0, cov=0, v1=0, v2=0;
   for(int i=0;i<CorrPeriod;i++){m1+=c1[i];m2+=c2[i];}m1/=CorrPeriod;m2/=CorrPeriod;
   for(int i=0;i<CorrPeriod;i++){cov+=(c1[i]-m1)*(c2[i]-m2);v1+=MathPow(c1[i]-m1,2);v2+=MathPow(c2[i]-m2,2);}
   return(v1>0&&v2>0)?cov/MathSqrt(v1*v2):0;
}

void PairExit()
{
   if(CntPos() == 0) return;
   double z = ZScore();
   bool eTP=MathAbs(z)<ZExit, eSL=MathAbs(z)>ZHardSL, eDD=DDHit(), eTime=false;
   for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++)
   {
      ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;
      if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;
      if((TimeCurrent()-(datetime)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TIME))>=(datetime)(MaxHoldD*86400))eTime=true;
   }
   if(eTP||eSL||eTime||eDD) CloseAll();
}

int OnInit(){trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(Magic);SymbolSelect(Symbol2,true);return INIT_SUCCEEDED;}
void OnDeinit(const int r){}

void OnTick()
{
   static datetime lb = 0;
   datetime cb = iTime(_Symbol, TF_Main, 0);
   if(cb == lb) return; lb = cb;
   if(DDHit()) { CloseAll(); return; }
   PairExit();
   if(DayHit()) return;
   if(CntPos() >= 2) return;
   if(Corr() > CorrMin) return;
   double z = ZScore(); if(z == EMPTY_VALUE) return;

   double lot = CalcLot();
   double a1=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK),b1=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID);
   double a2=SymbolInfoDouble(Symbol2,SYMBOL_ASK),b2=SymbolInfoDouble(Symbol2,SYMBOL_BID);

   if(z < -ZEntry){ trade.Buy(lot,_Symbol,a1,0,0,"AD_B1"); trade.Sell(lot,Symbol2,b2,0,0,"AD_S2"); }
   else if(z > ZEntry){ trade.Sell(lot,_Symbol,b1,0,0,"AD_S1"); trade.Buy(lot,Symbol2,a2,0,0,"AD_B2"); }
}
```

```mql5
double CalcLot(double slDist)
{
   double ls = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP);
   double mn = MathMax(Lot_Min, SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN));
   double mx = MathMin(Lot_Max, SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX));
   if(!Lot_Dynamic){ double lot=MathFloor(Lot_Fixed/ls)*ls; return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,lot)); }
   double base = Lot_UseEquity ? AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY) : AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);

   double lot = risk / (slDist / ts * tv);
   lot = MathFloor(lot / ls) * ls;

PV CalcPV(ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf, int sh)
{
   PV p={0,0,0,0,0};
   double hi[1],lo[1],cl[1];
   ArraySetAsSeries(hi,true);ArraySetAsSeries(lo,true);ArraySetAsSeries(cl,true);
   if(CopyHigh(_Symbol,tf,sh,1,hi)<1) return p;
   if(CopyLow(_Symbol, tf,sh,1,lo)<1) return p;
   if(CopyClose(_Symbol,tf,sh,1,cl)<1) return p;
   p.PP=(hi[0]+lo[0]+cl[0])/3.0;
   p.R1=2*p.PP-lo[0]; p.R2=p.PP+(hi[0]-lo[0]);
   p.S1=2*p.PP-hi[0]; p.S2=p.PP-(hi[0]-lo[0]);
   return p;
}

int OnInit()
{
   hRSI = iRSI(_Symbol, TF_Entry, RSI_Period, PRICE_CLOSE);
   hCCI = iCCI(_Symbol, TF_Entry, CCI_Period, PRICE_TYPICAL);
   hATR = iATR(_Symbol, TF_Entry, ATR_Period);
   hADX = iADX(_Symbol, TF_Entry, ADX_Period);
   trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(Magic);
   return INIT_SUCCEEDED;
}
void OnDeinit(const int r){IndicatorRelease(hRSI);IndicatorRelease(hCCI);IndicatorRelease(hATR);IndicatorRelease(hADX);}

void OnTick()
{
   static datetime lb = 0;
   datetime cb = iTime(_Symbol, TF_Entry, 0);
   if(cb == lb) return; lb = cb;
   if(DDHit()) { CloseAll(); return; }
   if(DayHit()) return;
   if(CntPos() >= (int)MathMin(MaxPos, 5)) return;

   double adxV[2]; CopyBuffer(hADX, MAIN_LINE, 0, 2, adxV);
   if(adxV[0] > ADX_Max) return;

   PV mn = CalcPV(PivotHTF, 1);
   PV wk = CalcPV(PivotMTF, 1);

   double px = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   double av[2]; CopyBuffer(hATR, 0, 0, 2, av);
   double atr = av[0], zone = atr * Zone_Mult;
   double slDist = CalcSL(atr);

   double rv[2], cv[2];
   CopyBuffer(hRSI, 0, 0, 2, rv);
   CopyBuffer(hCCI, 0, 0, 2, cv);

   bool nS1=MathAbs(px-wk.S1)<=zone, nS2=MathAbs(px-wk.S2)<=zone;
   bool nR1=MathAbs(px-wk.R1)<=zone, nR2=MathAbs(px-wk.R2)<=zone;
   bool mBull=px>mn.S1, mBear=px<mn.R1;

   if((nS1||nS2) && rv[0]<40 && cv[0]<-80 && mBull)
   {
      double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
      double sl  = (nS2 ? wk.S2 : wk.S2 - atr) - slDist;
      // TP: Dynamic=Next Pivot / Fixed=Pips
      double tp  = TP_Dynamic ? (nS1 ? wk.PP : wk.S1)
                              : ask + TP_Fixed_Pips * GetPip();
      if(sl < ask && tp > ask)
         trade.Buy(CalcLot(ask-sl), _Symbol, ask, sl, tp, "GE_B");
   }
   else if((nR1||nR2) && rv[0]>60 && cv[0]>80 && mBear)
   {
      double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
      double sl  = (nR2 ? wk.R2 : wk.R2 + atr) + slDist;
      double tp  = TP_Dynamic ? (nR1 ? wk.PP : wk.R1)
                              : bid - TP_Fixed_Pips * GetPip();
      if(sl > bid && tp < bid)
         trade.Sell(CalcLot(sl-bid), _Symbol, bid, sl, tp, "GE_S");
   }
}
```

```mql5
void OnTick()
{
   static datetime lb = 0;
   datetime cb = iTime(_Symbol, TF_Main, 0);
   if(cb == lb) return; lb = cb;
   if(DDHit()) { CloseAll(); return; }

   MqlDateTime dt; TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(), dt);
   datetime today = StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d", dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));
   if(today != lastDay) { trades = 0; lastDay = today; }

   if(!InSess()) return;
   if(trades >= MaxTrades) return;
   if(DayHit()) return;
   if(CntPos() >= (int)MathMin(MaxPos, 5)) return;

   double ef[3], es[3];
   CopyBuffer(hEF, 0, 0, 3, ef); CopyBuffer(hES, 0, 0, 3, es);
   bool xUp = ef[1]>es[1] && ef[2]<=es[2];
   bool xDn = ef[1]<es[1] && ef[2]>=es[2];

   long vArr[]; ArraySetAsSeries(vArr, true);
   CopyTickVolume(_Symbol, TF_Main, 1, Vol_Period, vArr);
   double avgV = 0; for(int i=0;i<Vol_Period;i++) avgV+=vArr[i]; avgV/=Vol_Period;
   bool vOK = iVolume(_Symbol, TF_Main, 1) > avgV * Vol_Mult;

   double sl = CalcSL();
   double tp = CalcTP();

   if(xUp && vOK)
   {
      double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
      if(trade.Buy(CalcLot(sl), _Symbol, ask, ask-sl, ask+tp, "TF_B")) trades++;
   }
   else if(xDn && vOK)
   {
      double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
      if(trade.Sell(CalcLot(sl), _Symbol, bid, bid+sl, bid-tp, "TF_S")) trades++;
   }
}
```

```mql5
double GetPip(){double pt=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_POINT);int dg=(int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol,SYMBOL_DIGITS);return(dg==5||dg==3)?pt*10.0:pt;}

double CalcLot(double slDist)
{
   double ls = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP);
   double mn = MathMax(Lot_Min, SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN));
   double mx = MathMin(Lot_Max, SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX));
   if(!Lot_Dynamic){ double lot=MathFloor(Lot_Fixed/ls)*ls; return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,lot)); }
   double base = Lot_UseEquity ? AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY) : AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
   double risk = base * Lot_RiskPct / 100.0;
   double tv = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);
   double ts = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE);
   if(slDist<=0||tv<=0||ts<=0) return mn;
   double lot = risk / (slDist / ts * tv);
   lot = MathFloor(lot / ls) * ls;
   return MathMax(mn, MathMin(mx, lot));
}

double CalcSL()
{
   if(!SL_Dynamic) return SL_Fixed_Pips * GetPip();
   double av[2]; CopyBuffer(hATR, 0, 0, 2, av); return av[0] * SL_ATR_Mult;
}

double CalcTP()
{
   if(!TP_Dynamic) return TP_Fixed_Pips * GetPip();
   double av[2]; CopyBuffer(hATR, 0, 0, 2, av); return av[0] * TP_ATR_Mult;
}

double CalcPCDist()
{
   if(!PC_Dynamic) return PC_Fixed_Pips * GetPip();
   double av[2]; CopyBuffer(hATR, 0, 0, 2, av); return av[0] * PC_ATR_Mult;
}

void DoPC()
{
   if(!PC_Enable) return;
   double pcDist = CalcPCDist();
   double pip    = GetPip();
   for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i >= 0; i--)
   {
      ulong t = PositionGetTicket(i); if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t)) continue;
      if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != Magic) continue;
      if(StringFind(PositionGetString(POSITION_COMMENT), "_PC") >= 0) continue;
      double op  = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PRICE_OPEN);
      double vol = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_VOLUME);
      long   ty  = PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);
      double curP = (ty==POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID)
                                            : SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK);
      double profit = (ty==POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? curP-op : op-curP;
      if(profit >= pcDist)
      {
         double ls = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP);
         double mn = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN);
         double cl = MathFloor(vol*PC_Pct/100.0/ls)*ls;
         if(cl >= mn && (vol-cl) >= mn)
            if(trade.PositionClosePartial(t, cl))
               trade.PositionModify(t, op, PositionGetDouble(POSITION_TP));
      }
   }
}

int OnInit()
{
   hEMA = iMA(_Symbol,       TF_Main, EMA_Period, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
   hRSI = iRSI(_Symbol,      TF_Main, RSI_Period, PRICE_CLOSE);
   hMOM = iMomentum(_Symbol, TF_Main, Mom_Period, PRICE_CLOSE);
   hATR = iATR(_Symbol,      TF_Main, ATR_Period);
   trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(Magic);
   return INIT_SUCCEEDED;
}
void OnDeinit(const int r){IndicatorRelease(hEMA);IndicatorRelease(hRSI);IndicatorRelease(hMOM);IndicatorRelease(hATR);}

void OnTick()
{
   static datetime lb = 0;
   datetime cb = iTime(_Symbol, TF_Main, 0);
   if(cb == lb) return; lb = cb;
   if(DDHit()) { CloseAll(); return; }
   DoPC();
   if(DayHit()) return;
   if(CntPos() >= (int)MathMin(MaxPos, 5)) return;

   double ema[2]; CopyBuffer(hEMA, 0, 0, 2, ema);
   double px = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   bool bull = px > ema[0], bear = px < ema[0];

   double rv[2], mv[3];
   CopyBuffer(hRSI, 0, 0, 2, rv); CopyBuffer(hMOM, 0, 0, 3, mv);
   bool mBull = rv[0]>50 && mv[0]>100 && mv[1]<=100;
   bool mBear = rv[0]<50 && mv[0]<100 && mv[1]>=100;

   double o1=iOpen(_Symbol,TF_Main,1), c1=iClose(_Symbol,TF_Main,1);
   double o2=iOpen(_Symbol,TF_Main,2), c2=iClose(_Symbol,TF_Main,2);
   bool bE = c1>o1 && c2<o2 && c1>o2 && o1<c2;
   bool sE = c1<o1 && c2>o2 && c1<o2 && o1>c2;

   double sl = CalcSL();
   double tp = CalcTP();

   if(bull && mBull && bE)
   { double ask=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK); trade.Buy(CalcLot(sl),_Symbol,ask,ask-sl,ask+tp,"BA_B"); }
   else if(bear && mBear && sE)
   { double bid=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID); trade.Sell(CalcLot(sl),_Symbol,bid,bid+sl,bid-tp,"BA_S"); }
}
```

```mql5
void Straddle()
{
   double atr    = GetATR();
   double spread = GetSpread();
   if(spread > atr * 0.05 * SpreadMult) return;

   double enDist = CalcEnDist(atr);
   double slDist = CalcSL(atr);
   double tpDist = CalcTP(atr);
   double lot    = CalcLot(slDist);

   double ask = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_ASK);
   double bid = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_BID);
   double eB  = ask + enDist;
   double eS  = bid - enDist;

   trade.BuyStop(lot,  eB, _Symbol, eB-slDist, eB+tpDist, ORDER_TIME_GTC, 0, "SE_BS");
   trade.SellStop(lot, eS, _Symbol, eS+slDist, eS-tpDist, ORDER_TIME_GTC, 0, "SE_SS");
   evToday++;
}

{
   MqlDateTime dt; TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(), dt);
   datetime today = StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d", dt.year, dt.mon, dt.day));
   if(today != lastDay){ evToday=0; lastDay=today; nT1=0; nT2=0; }
   if(DDHit()){ CloseAll(); return; }
   TStopChk(); CancelOpp();
   if(DayHit()) return;
   if(evToday >= MaxEv) return;
   if(nT1==0) nT1=StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d %s",dt.year,dt.mon,dt.day,NewsTime1));
   if(nT2==0) nT2=StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d %s",dt.year,dt.mon,dt.day,NewsTime2));
   datetime gmt = TimeGMT();
   bool fire = (gmt>=nT1-MinBef*60&&gmt<nT1-(MinBef-1)*60)||(gmt>=nT2-MinBef*60&&gmt<nT2-(MinBef-1)*60);
   if(fire && OrdersTotal()==0 && PositionsTotal()==0) Straddle();
}
```

```mql5
bool DayHit(){double b=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),lim=b*MaxDay_Pct/100.0;datetime d0=StringToTime(TimeToString(TimeCurrent(),TIME_DATE));double pl=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;pl+=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)+PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);}HistorySelect(d0,TimeCurrent());for(int i=0;i<HistoryDealsTotal();i++){ulong d=HistoryDealGetTicket(i);if((int)HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;if(HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_ENTRY)==DEAL_ENTRY_OUT)pl+=HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_PROFIT)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_SWAP)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_COMMISSION);}return pl<=-lim;}
void CloseAll(){for(int i=PositionsTotal()-1;i>=0;i--){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)trade.PositionClose(t);}}

int CalcST(double atr)
{
   double hi=iHigh(_Symbol,TF_Entry,1),lo=iLow(_Symbol,TF_Entry,1);
   double c1=iClose(_Symbol,TF_Entry,1),c2=iClose(_Symbol,TF_Entry,2);
   double hl2=(hi+lo)/2.0;
   double up=hl2+ST_Mult*atr,dn=hl2-ST_Mult*atr;
   double fU=(pU>0&&(up<pU||c2>pU))?up:pU;
   double fL=(pL>0&&(dn>pL||c2<pL))?dn:pL;
   if(pU==0)fU=up; if(pL==0)fL=dn;
   int tr=(c1>fU)?1:(c1<fL?-1:pT);
   int sig=0; if(tr==1&&pT!=1)sig=1; if(tr==-1&&pT!=-1)sig=-1;
   pU=fU; pL=fL; pT=tr; return sig;
}

void ManageDW()
{
   double adxV[2]; CopyBuffer(hADX, MAIN_LINE, 0, 2, adxV);
   if(adxV[0] < ADX_Exit || DDHit()) { CloseAll(); return; }

   double ae[2]; CopyBuffer(hATR_E, 0, 0, 2, ae);
   double hi=iHigh(_Symbol,TF_Entry,1), lo=iLow(_Symbol,TF_Entry,1);
   double hl2=(hi+lo)/2.0;

   for(int i = PositionsTotal()-1; i >= 0; i--)
   {
      ulong t = PositionGetTicket(i); if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t)) continue;
      if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) != Magic) continue;
      if(PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT) <= 0) continue;
      double sl  = PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL);
      long   ty  = PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);
      double px  = (ty==POSITION_TYPE_BUY) ? SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID)
                                           : SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK);
      double tB, tS;
      if(Trail_Dynamic)
      { tB = hl2 - Trail_ST_Mult * ae[0]; tS = hl2 + Trail_ST_Mult * ae[0]; }
      else
      { tB = px - Trail_Fixed_Pips * GetPip(); tS = px + Trail_Fixed_Pips * GetPip(); }

      if(ty==POSITION_TYPE_BUY  && tB>sl) trade.PositionModify(t, tB, 0);
      if(ty==POSITION_TYPE_SELL && tS<sl) trade.PositionModify(t, tS, 0);
   }
}

int OnInit()
{
   hEF     = iMA(_Symbol,  TF_Macro,  EMA_Fast, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
   hES     = iMA(_Symbol,  TF_Macro,  EMA_Slow, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
   hADX    = iADX(_Symbol, TF_Filter, ADX_Period);
   hATR_E  = iATR(_Symbol, TF_Entry,  ST_Period);
   hATR_SL = iATR(_Symbol, TF_Filter, ATR_SL_Per);
   pU=0; pL=0; pT=0;
   trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(Magic);
   return INIT_SUCCEEDED;
}
void OnDeinit(const int r){IndicatorRelease(hEF);IndicatorRelease(hES);IndicatorRelease(hADX);IndicatorRelease(hATR_E);IndicatorRelease(hATR_SL);}

void OnTick()
{
   static datetime lb = 0;
   datetime cb = iTime(_Symbol, TF_Entry, 0);
   if(cb == lb) return; lb = cb;
   if(DDHit()) { CloseAll(); return; }
   if(CntPos() > 0) { ManageDW(); return; }
   if(DayHit()) return;
   if(CntPos() >= (int)MathMin(MaxPos, 5)) return;

   double ef[2], es[2];
   CopyBuffer(hEF, 0, 0, 2, ef); CopyBuffer(hES, 0, 0, 2, es);
   bool hBull = ef[0]>es[0], hBear = ef[0]<es[0];

   double adxV[2]; CopyBuffer(hADX, MAIN_LINE, 0, 2, adxV);
   if(adxV[0] < ADX_Min) return;

   double ae[3]; CopyBuffer(hATR_E, 0, 0, 3, ae);
   int sig = CalcST(ae[1]);

   double as2[2]; CopyBuffer(hATR_SL, 0, 0, 2, as2);
   double slDist = CalcSL(as2[0]);

   if(hBull && sig==1)
   { double ask=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK); trade.Buy(CalcLot(slDist),_Symbol,ask,ask-slDist,0,"DW_B"); }
   else if(hBear && sig==-1)
   { double bid=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID); trade.Sell(CalcLot(slDist),_Symbol,bid,bid+slDist,0,"DW_S"); }
}
```

```mql5
//| v3.0 — Dynamic/Fixed Lot + SL + TP                              |

#property copyright "Port 141058396"
#property version   "3.00"
#include <Trade\Trade.mqh>
CTrade trade;

input group "═══ Timeframe ═══"

double GetPip(){double pt=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_POINT);int dg=(int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol,SYMBOL_DIGITS);return(dg==5||dg==3)?pt*10.0:pt;}

double CalcLot(double slDist)
{
   double ls = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP);
   double mn = MathMax(Lot_Min, SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN));
   double mx = MathMin(Lot_Max, SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX));
   if(!Lot_Dynamic){ double lot=MathFloor(Lot_Fixed/ls)*ls; return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,lot)); }
   double base = Lot_UseEquity ? AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY) : AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
   double risk = base * Lot_RiskPct / 100.0;
   double tv = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);
   double ts = SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol, SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE);
   if(slDist<=0||tv<=0||ts<=0) return mn;
   double lot = risk / (slDist / ts * tv);
   lot = MathFloor(lot / ls) * ls;
   return MathMax(mn, MathMin(mx, lot));
}

double CalcSL()
{
   if(!SL_Dynamic) return SL_Fixed_Pips * GetPip();
   double av[2]; CopyBuffer(hATR, 0, 0, 2, av); return av[0] * SL_ATR_Mult;
}

double CalcTP()
{
   if(!TP_Dynamic) return TP_Fixed_Pips * GetPip();
   double av[2]; CopyBuffer(hATR, 0, 0, 2, av); return av[0] * TP_ATR_Mult;
}

int CntPos(){int n=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)n++;}return n;}
bool DDHit(){double b=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),e=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);return b>0&&(b-e)/b*100.0>=MaxDD_Pct;}
bool DayHit(){double b=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),lim=b*MaxDay_Pct/100.0;datetime d0=StringToTime(TimeToString(TimeCurrent(),TIME_DATE));double pl=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;pl+=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)+PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);}HistorySelect(d0,TimeCurrent());for(int i=0;i<HistoryDealsTotal();i++){ulong d=HistoryDealGetTicket(i);if((int)HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;if(HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_ENTRY)==DEAL_ENTRY_OUT)pl+=HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_PROFIT)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_SWAP)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_COMMISSION);}return pl<=-lim;}
void CloseAll(){for(int i=PositionsTotal()-1;i>=0;i--){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)trade.PositionClose(t);}}
bool InSess(){MqlDateTime dt;TimeToStruct(TimeGMT(),dt);return dt.hour>=SessStart&&dt.hour<SessEnd;}

int OnInit()
{
   hEF_T = iMA(_Symbol,  TF_Trend, EMA_Fast, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
   hES_T = iMA(_Symbol,  TF_Trend, EMA_Slow, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
   hEF_E = iMA(_Symbol,  TF_Entry, EMA_Fast, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
   hES_E = iMA(_Symbol,  TF_Entry, EMA_Slow, 0, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE);
   hRSI  = iRSI(_Symbol, TF_Entry, RSI_Period, PRICE_CLOSE);
   hATR  = iATR(_Symbol, TF_Entry, ATR_Period);
   trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(Magic);
   return INIT_SUCCEEDED;
}
void OnDeinit(const int r){IndicatorRelease(hEF_T);IndicatorRelease(hES_T);IndicatorRelease(hEF_E);IndicatorRelease(hES_E);IndicatorRelease(hRSI);IndicatorRelease(hATR);}

void OnTick()
{
   static datetime lb = 0;
   datetime cb = iTime(_Symbol, TF_Entry, 0);
   if(cb == lb) return; lb = cb;
   if(DDHit()) { CloseAll(); return; }
   if(!InSess()) { if(!fc){ CloseAll(); fc=true; } return; }
   fc = false;
   if(DayHit()) return;
   if(CntPos() >= (int)MathMin(MaxPos, 5)) return;

   double eft[2], est[2];
   CopyBuffer(hEF_T, 0, 0, 2, eft); CopyBuffer(hES_T, 0, 0, 2, est);
   bool tBull = eft[0]>est[0], tBear = eft[0]<est[0];

   double efe[3], ese[3], rv[2];
   CopyBuffer(hEF_E, 0, 0, 3, efe); CopyBuffer(hES_E, 0, 0, 3, ese);
   CopyBuffer(hRSI,  0, 0, 2, rv);
   bool xUp = efe[1]>ese[1] && efe[2]<=ese[2] && rv[0]>50;
   bool xDn = efe[1]<ese[1] && efe[2]>=ese[2] && rv[0]<50;

   double sl = CalcSL();
   double tp = CalcTP();

   if(tBull && xUp)
   { double ask=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK); trade.Buy(CalcLot(sl),_Symbol,ask,ask-sl,ask+tp,"ES_B"); }
   else if(tBear && xDn)
   { double bid=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID); trade.Sell(CalcLot(sl),_Symbol,bid,bid+sl,bid-tp,"ES_S"); }
}
```

## สรุป Input Groups ที่เพิ่มในทุก EA

| Parameter | Dynamic Mode | Fixed Mode |
|---|---|---|
| **Lot** | `Lot_RiskPct` % ของ Balance/Equity | `Lot_Fixed` คงที่ |
| **SL** | `SL_ATR_Mult` × ATR | `SL_Fixed_Pips` Pips |
| **TP** | `TP_ATR_Mult` × ATR | `TP_Fixed_Pips` Pips |
| **Grid Distance** (Port 2) | `Dist_ATR_Mult` × ATR | `Dist_Fixed_Pips` Pips |
| **Entry Distance** (Port 3,9) | `En_ATR_Mult` × ATR | `En_Fixed_Pips` Pips |
| **Basket TP/SL** (Port 2) | `BasketTP_Pct` % ของ Balance | `BasketTP_Fixed` Dollar |
| **Partial Close** (Port 8) | `PC_ATR_Mult` × ATR | `PC_Fixed_Pips` Pips |
| **Trail** (Port 1,3,10) | ATR/Supertrend Based | Fixed Pips |

> **วิธีใช้:** เปลี่ยน `Lot_Dynamic = false` เพื่อล็อก Lot คงที่ เปลี่ยน `SL_Dynamic = false` เพื่อใช้ SL แบบ Fixed Pips ครับบอส 🔥

----- [user] -----
เพิ่ม Adaptive Thresholds ไปในทุก strategy เพื่อเพิ่มความ Dynamic ของ EA

----- [assistant] -----
ครับบอส — เพิ่ม Adaptive Thresholds เข้าไปทุก EA เลย โดยใช้หลักการคำนวณ Threshold อัตโนมัติจาก Market Condition

## แนวคิด Adaptive Thresholds

```
แทนที่จะใช้ค่าคงที่ เช่น ADX > 25 ตลอดเวลา
ให้คำนวณจาก Rolling Average ของ Indicator นั้นๆ

ตัวอย่าง:
  ADX_Adaptive  = Average ADX ของ N แท่งที่ผ่านมา × Multiplier
  RSI_OB_Adapt  = 100 - Average(RSI_Distance_From_50) × Factor
  BB_Width_Adapt = Average BB Width ของ N แท่ง
  Vol_Adapt      = Average Volume ของ N แท่ง (มีอยู่แล้ว)
```

## Adaptive Engine — Common Functions (ใช้ในทุก EA)

```mql5
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//  ADAPTIVE THRESHOLD ENGINE
//  Copy ส่วนนี้ไปใส่ใน EA แต่ละตัว ใต้ส่วน Input
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+

//--- คำนวณ Adaptive ADX Threshold
//    = Average ADX ของ period แท่งที่ผ่านมา × mult
//    ถ้าตลาดมี ADX เฉลี่ยสูงอยู่แล้ว Threshold ก็สูงตาม
double AdaptiveADX(int handle, int period, double mult, double minVal, double maxVal)
{
   double buf[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle, MAIN_LINE, 0, period, buf) < period) return minVal;
   double sum = 0;
   for(int i = 0; i < period; i++) sum += buf[i];
   double avg = sum / period;
   double result = avg * mult;
   return MathMax(minVal, MathMin(maxVal, result));
}

//--- คำนวณ Adaptive RSI Oversold/Overbought
//    โดยดูจาก RSI ที่ผ่านมาว่ามัน Extreme แค่ไหน
//    OB = 50 + Average(|RSI - 50|) × mult
//    OS = 50 - Average(|RSI - 50|) × mult
void AdaptiveRSI(int handle, int period, double mult,
                 double &osLevel, double &obLevel,
                 double minOS=15.0, double maxOS=40.0,
                 double minOB=60.0, double maxOB=85.0)
{
   double buf[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, period, buf) < period)
   { osLevel=30.0; obLevel=70.0; return; }
   double sumDist = 0;
   for(int i = 0; i < period; i++) sumDist += MathAbs(buf[i] - 50.0);
   double avgDist = sumDist / period;
   obLevel = MathMax(minOB, MathMin(maxOB, 50.0 + avgDist * mult));
   osLevel = MathMax(minOS, MathMin(maxOS, 50.0 - avgDist * mult));
}

//--- คำนวณ Adaptive BB Width Threshold
//    = Average BB Width ของ period แท่ง × mult
double AdaptiveBBWidth(int handle, int period, double mult,
                       double minVal=0.005, double maxVal=0.08)
{
   double upper[], lower[], middle[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(upper,  true);
   ArraySetAsSeries(lower,  true);
   ArraySetAsSeries(middle, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle, 1, 0, period, upper)  < period) return minVal;
   if(CopyBuffer(handle, 2, 0, period, lower)  < period) return minVal;
   if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, period, middle) < period) return minVal;
   double sumW = 0;
   for(int i = 0; i < period; i++)
      if(middle[i] > 0) sumW += (upper[i]-lower[i])/middle[i];
   double avg = sumW / period;
   return MathMax(minVal, MathMin(maxVal, avg * mult));
}

//--- คำนวณ Adaptive ATR Multiplier
//    ถ้า Volatility สูง (ATR ใหญ่) ให้ SL/TP กว้างขึ้น
//    Norm_ATR = ATR ปัจจุบัน / Average ATR ของ period แท่ง
//    Return: normalized multiplier (0.5 - 2.0)
double AdaptiveATRMult(int handle, int period,
                       double baseMult, double minMult=0.5, double maxMult=2.5)
{
   double buf[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, period+1, buf) < period+1) return baseMult;
   double curATR = buf[0];
   double sum = 0;
   for(int i = 1; i <= period; i++) sum += buf[i];
   double avgATR = sum / period;
   if(avgATR <= 0) return baseMult;
   double ratio = curATR / avgATR;          // >1 = Volatile, <1 = Quiet
   double result = baseMult * ratio;
   return MathMax(minMult, MathMin(maxMult, result));
}

//--- คำนวณ Adaptive Volume Threshold
//    = Average Volume × mult (ปรับตาม Session/Volatility)
double AdaptiveVolMult(string symbol, ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf,
                       int period, double baseMult,
                       double minMult=1.0, double maxMult=3.0)
{
   long vArr[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(vArr, true);
   if(CopyTickVolume(symbol, tf, 1, period*2, vArr) < period*2) return baseMult;
   // Short-term avg vs Long-term avg
   double shortSum = 0, longSum = 0;
   for(int i = 0; i < period; i++)     shortSum += vArr[i];
   for(int i = period; i < period*2; i++) longSum += vArr[i];
   double shortAvg = shortSum / period;
   double longAvg  = longSum  / period;
   if(longAvg <= 0) return baseMult;
   // ถ้า Volume ช่วงสั้นสูงกว่าช่วงยาว = กำลัง Active
   double ratio = shortAvg / longAvg;
   double result = baseMult / ratio;    // ถ้า Active แล้ว Threshold ต่ำลง (เข้าง่ายขึ้น)
   return MathMax(minMult, MathMin(maxMult, result));
}

//--- คำนวณ Adaptive Zone (สำหรับ Pivot)
//    Zone = ATR × Mult แต่ปรับตาม Volatility Regime
double AdaptiveZone(int atrHandle, int period,
                    double baseMult, double minMult=0.1, double maxMult=0.8)
{
   double buf[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(atrHandle, 0, 0, period+1, buf) < period+1)
      return buf[0] * baseMult;
   double curATR = buf[0];
   double sum = 0;
   for(int i = 1; i <= period; i++) sum += buf[i];
   double avgATR = sum / period;
   if(avgATR <= 0) return curATR * baseMult;
   double ratio  = curATR / avgATR;
   double mult   = baseMult / ratio;   // Volatile = Zone แคบลง (แม่นขึ้น)
   return curATR * MathMax(minMult, MathMin(maxMult, mult));
}
```

## PORT 1 — EA_CelestialWoodfire_141049900.mq5 (Adaptive)

```mql5
input double Lot_Max        = 5.0;

input group "═══ Trailing ═══"
input bool   UseTrail         = true;
input double Trail_ATR_Mult   = 1.0;

input group "═══ Money Management ═══"

//────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  ADAPTIVE ENGINE
//────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
double AdaptiveADX(int handle, int period, double mult, double mn, double mx)
{
   double buf[]; ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle, MAIN_LINE, 0, period, buf) < period) return mn;
   double sum = 0;
   for(int i = 0; i < period; i++) sum += buf[i];
   return MathMax(mn, MathMin(mx, (sum/period) * mult));
}

double AdaptiveATRMult(int handle, int period, double base, double mn, double mx)
{
   double buf[]; ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, period+1, buf) < period+1) return base;
   double cur = buf[0], sum = 0;
   for(int i = 1; i <= period; i++) sum += buf[i];
   double avg = sum / period;
   if(avg <= 0) return base;
   return MathMax(mn, MathMin(mx, base * (cur/avg)));
}

//────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
double GetPip(){double pt=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_POINT);int dg=(int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol,SYMBOL_DIGITS);return(dg==5||dg==3)?pt*10.0:pt;}
int CntPos(){int n=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)n++;}return n;}

double CalcLot(double slDist)
{
   double ls=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP);
   double mn=MathMax(Lot_Min,SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN));
   double mx=MathMin(Lot_Max,SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX));
   if(!Lot_Dynamic){double lot=MathFloor(Lot_Fixed/ls)*ls;return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,lot));}
   double base=Lot_UseEquity?AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY):AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
   double risk=base*Lot_RiskPct/100.0;
   double tv=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);
   double ts=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE);
   if(slDist<=0||tv<=0||ts<=0)return mn;
   double lot=risk/(slDist/ts*tv);
   lot=MathFloor(lot/ls)*ls;
   return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,lot));
}

void DoTrail(double atr)
{
   double td = atr * Trail_ATR_Mult;
   double ef[2]; CopyBuffer(hEF_C, 0, 0, 2, ef);
   for(int i=PositionsTotal()-1;i>=0;i--)
   {
      ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;
      if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;
      if(PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)<=0)continue;
      double sl=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL),tp=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_TP);
      long ty=PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);
      if(ty==POSITION_TYPE_BUY){double n=ef[0]-td;if(n>sl&&n<SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID))trade.PositionModify(t,n,tp);}
      else{double n=ef[0]+td;if(n<sl&&n>SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK))trade.PositionModify(t,n,tp);}
   }
}

int OnInit()
{
   hEF_T=iMA(_Symbol,TF_Trend,EMA_Fast,0,MODE_EMA,PRICE_CLOSE);
   hES_T=iMA(_Symbol,TF_Trend,EMA_Slow,0,MODE_EMA,PRICE_CLOSE);
   hEF_C=iMA(_Symbol,TF_Confirm,EMA_Fast,0,MODE_EMA,PRICE_CLOSE);
   hES_C=iMA(_Symbol,TF_Confirm,EMA_Slow,0,MODE_EMA,PRICE_CLOSE);
   hMACD=iMACD(_Symbol,TF_Entry,MACD_Fast,MACD_Slow,MACD_Sig,PRICE_CLOSE);
   hADX=iADX(_Symbol,TF_Entry,ADX_Period);
   hATR=iATR(_Symbol,TF_Entry,ATR_Period);
   trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(Magic);
   return INIT_SUCCEEDED;
}
void OnDeinit(const int r){IndicatorRelease(hEF_T);IndicatorRelease(hES_T);IndicatorRelease(hEF_C);IndicatorRelease(hES_C);IndicatorRelease(hMACD);IndicatorRelease(hADX);IndicatorRelease(hATR);}

void OnTick()
{
   static datetime lb=0;
   datetime cb=iTime(_Symbol,TF_Entry,0);
   if(cb==lb)return;lb=cb;
   if(DDHit()){CloseAll();return;}

   double atr_v[2]; CopyBuffer(hATR,0,0,2,atr_v);
   double atr=atr_v[0];

   //--- คำนวณ Adaptive Thresholds
   double adxThresh, slMult, tpMult;
   if(Adaptive_Enable)
   {
      adxThresh = AdaptiveADX(hADX, Adapt_LookbackADX,
                              Adapt_ADX_Mult, Adapt_ADX_Min, Adapt_ADX_Max);
      slMult    = AdaptiveATRMult(hATR, Adapt_LookbackATR,
                                  Adapt_SL_BaseMult, Adapt_SL_Min, Adapt_SL_Max);
      tpMult    = AdaptiveATRMult(hATR, Adapt_LookbackATR,
                                  Adapt_TP_BaseMult, Adapt_TP_Min, Adapt_TP_Max);
   }
   else
   { adxThresh=Fixed_ADX_Min; slMult=Fixed_SL_ATR; tpMult=Fixed_TP_ATR; }

   Comment(StringFormat(
      "CelestialWoodfire v4 | Adaptive: %s\n"
      "ADX Threshold: %.1f | SL Mult: %.2f | TP Mult: %.2f\n"
      "ATR: %.5f",
      Adaptive_Enable?"ON":"OFF", adxThresh, slMult, tpMult, atr));

   if(UseTrail) DoTrail(atr);
   if(DayHit()) return;
   if(CntPos()>=(int)MathMin(MaxPos,5)) return;

   double eft[2],est[2],efc[2],esc[2];
   CopyBuffer(hEF_T,0,0,2,eft);CopyBuffer(hES_T,0,0,2,est);
   CopyBuffer(hEF_C,0,0,2,efc);CopyBuffer(hES_C,0,0,2,esc);
   bool tBull=eft[0]>est[0],tBear=eft[0]<est[0];
   bool cBull=efc[0]>esc[0],cBear=efc[0]<esc[0];

   double mm[3],ms[3],adx[2];
   CopyBuffer(hMACD,MAIN_LINE,0,3,mm);CopyBuffer(hMACD,SIGNAL_LINE,0,3,ms);
   CopyBuffer(hADX,MAIN_LINE,0,2,adx);
   bool mUp=mm[1]>ms[1]&&mm[2]<=ms[2];
   bool mDn=mm[1]<ms[1]&&mm[2]>=ms[2];

   double slDist=atr*slMult;
   double tpDist=atr*tpMult;

   if(tBull&&cBull&&mUp&&adx[0]>adxThresh)
   {double ask=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK);trade.Buy(CalcLot(slDist),_Symbol,ask,ask-slDist,ask+tpDist,"CW_B");}
   else if(tBear&&cBear&&mDn&&adx[0]>adxThresh)
   {double bid=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID);trade.Sell(CalcLot(slDist),_Symbol,bid,bid+slDist,bid-tpDist,"CW_S");}
}
```

```mql5
void AdaptiveRSI(int handle,int period,double multOS,double multOB,
                 double &os,double &ob)
{
   double buf[];ArraySetAsSeries(buf,true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle,0,0,period,buf)<period){os=30;ob=70;return;}
   double sumLow=0,sumHigh=0;int cntL=0,cntH=0;
   for(int i=0;i<period;i++)
   {
      if(buf[i]<50){sumLow+=buf[i];cntL++;}
      else{sumHigh+=buf[i];cntH++;}
   }
   os=(cntL>0)?MathMax(15,MathMin(40,(sumLow/cntL)*multOS)):30;
   ob=(cntH>0)?MathMax(60,MathMin(85,(sumHigh/cntH)*multOB)):70;
}

double AdaptiveBBWidth(int handle,int period,double mult)
{
   double up[],lo[],mid[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(up,true);ArraySetAsSeries(lo,true);ArraySetAsSeries(mid,true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle,1,0,period,up)<period)return 0.03;
   if(CopyBuffer(handle,2,0,period,lo)<period)return 0.03;
   if(CopyBuffer(handle,0,0,period,mid)<period)return 0.03;
   double sum=0;
   for(int i=0;i<period;i++)if(mid[i]>0)sum+=(up[i]-lo[i])/mid[i];
   return MathMax(0.005,MathMin(0.08,(sum/period)*mult));
}

   if(avg<=0)return base;

}

   double mn=MathMax(Lot_Min,SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN));
   double mx=MathMin(Lot_Max,SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX));

void BasketChk(double tpPct,double slPct)
{
   double bal=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),pl=0;int cnt=0;
   for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++)
   {ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;
    if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;
    pl+=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)+PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);cnt++;}
   if(cnt==0)return;
   if(pl>=bal*tpPct/100.0||pl<=-bal*slPct/100.0)CloseAll();
}
```

```mql5
double AdaptiveATRMult(int handle,int period,double base,double mn,double mx)
{
   double buf[];ArraySetAsSeries(buf,true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle,0,0,period+1,buf)<period+1)return base;
   double cur=buf[0],sum=0;
   for(int i=1;i<=period;i++)sum+=buf[i];
   double avg=sum/period;if(avg<=0)return base;
   return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,base*(cur/avg)));
}

double AdaptiveVolMult(ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf,int period,double base,double mn,double mx)
{
   long vArr[];ArraySetAsSeries(vArr,true);
   if(CopyTickVolume(_Symbol,tf,1,period*2,vArr)<period*2)return base;
   double sSum=0,lSum=0;
   for(int i=0;i<period;i++)sSum+=vArr[i];
   for(int i=period;i<period*2;i++)lSum+=vArr[i];
   double sAvg=sSum/period,lAvg=lSum/period;
   if(lAvg<=0)return base;
   return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,base/(sAvg/lAvg)));
}

double GetPip(){double pt=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_POINT);int dg=(int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol,SYMBOL_DIGITS);return(dg==5||dg==3)?pt*10.0:pt;}
int CntPos(){int n=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)n++;}return n;}
bool DDHit(){double b=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),e=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);return b>0&&(b-e)/b*100.0>=MaxDD_Pct;}
bool DayHit(){double b=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),lim=b*MaxDay_Pct/100.0;datetime d0=StringToTime(TimeToString(TimeCurrent(),TIME_DATE));double pl=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;pl+=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)+PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);}HistorySelect(d0,TimeCurrent());for(int i=0;i<HistoryDealsTotal();i++){ulong d=HistoryDealGetTicket(i);if((int)HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;if(HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_ENTRY)==DEAL_ENTRY_OUT)pl+=HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_PROFIT)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_SWAP)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_COMMISSION);}return pl<=-lim;}
void CloseAll(){for(int i=PositionsTotal()-1;i>=0;i--){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)trade.PositionClose(t);}}

double CalcLot(double slDist)
{
   double ls=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP);
   double mn=MathMax(Lot_Min,SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN));
   double mx=MathMin(Lot_Max,SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX));
   if(!Lot_Dynamic){double lot=MathFloor(Lot_Fixed/ls)*ls;return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,lot));}
   double base=Lot_UseEquity?AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY):AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
   double risk=base*Lot_RiskPct/100.0;
   double tv=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);
   double ts=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE);
   if(slDist<=0||tv<=0||ts<=0)return mn;
   double lot=risk/(slDist/ts*tv);lot=MathFloor(lot/ls)*ls;
   return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,lot));
}

void DelPend(){int sec=PeriodSeconds(TF_Entry);for(int i=OrdersTotal()-1;i>=0;i--){ulong t=OrderGetTicket(i);if(!OrderSelect(t))continue;if((int)OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;if((TimeCurrent()-(datetime)OrderGetInteger(ORDER_TIME_SETUP))>=sec)trade.OrderDelete(t);}}

void DoTrail(double atr)
{
   double td=atr*Trail_ATR_Mult;
   for(int i=PositionsTotal()-1;i>=0;i--)
   {ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;
    if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;
    if(PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)<=0)continue;
    double sl=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL),tp=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_TP);
    long ty=PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);
    if(ty==POSITION_TYPE_BUY){double n=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID)-td;if(n>sl)trade.PositionModify(t,n,tp);}
    else{double n=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK)+td;if(n<sl)trade.PositionModify(t,n,tp);}}
}

int OnInit(){hEMA=iMA(_Symbol,TF_Level,EMA_Period,0,MODE_EMA,PRICE_CLOSE);hATR_L=iATR(_Symbol,TF_Level,ATR_Period);hATR_E=iATR(_Symbol,TF_Entry,ATR_Period);trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(Magic);return INIT_SUCCEEDED;}
void OnDeinit(const int r){IndicatorRelease(hEMA);IndicatorRelease(hATR_L);IndicatorRelease(hATR_E);}

void OnTick()
{
   static datetime lb=0;
   datetime cb=iTime(_Symbol,TF_Entry,0);
   if(cb==lb)return;lb=cb;
   if(DDHit()){CloseAll();return;}
   DelPend();

   double ae[2];CopyBuffer(hATR_E,0,0,2,ae);double atr=ae[0];

   //--- Adaptive Thresholds

   if(Adaptive_Enable)
   {
      enMult  = AdaptiveATRMult(hATR_E,Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_En_BaseMult,Adapt_Mult_Min,Adapt_Mult_Max);
      slMult  = AdaptiveATRMult(hATR_E,Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_SL_BaseMult,Adapt_Mult_Min,Adapt_Mult_Max);
      tpMult  = AdaptiveATRMult(hATR_E,Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_TP_BaseMult,Adapt_Mult_Min,Adapt_Mult_Max);
      volMult = AdaptiveVolMult(TF_Entry,Vol_Period,Adapt_Vol_Mult,Adapt_Vol_Min,Adapt_Vol_Max);
   }
   else{enMult=Fixed_En_ATR;slMult=Fixed_SL_ATR;tpMult=Fixed_TP_ATR;volMult=Fixed_Vol_Mult;}

   if(UseTrail&&CntPos()>0){DoTrail(atr);return;}
   if(DayHit())return;
   if(CntPos()>=(int)MathMin(MaxPos,5))return;

   double ema[2];CopyBuffer(hEMA,0,0,2,ema);
   double px=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID);
   bool dBull=px>ema[0],dBear=px<ema[0];

   double hi[],lo[];ArraySetAsSeries(hi,true);ArraySetAsSeries(lo,true);
   CopyHigh(_Symbol,TF_Level,1,Don_Period,hi);CopyLow(_Symbol,TF_Level,1,Don_Period,lo);

   if(iVolume(_Symbol,TF_Entry,1)<avgV*volMult)return;

   double enDist=atr*enMult;
   double slDist=atr*slMult;
   double tpDist=atr*tpMult;

   Comment(StringFormat(
      "DawnAscendant v4 | Adaptive: %s\n"
      "En:%.2f SL:%.2f TP:%.2f Vol:%.2f (×ATR/Mult)\n"
      "ATR:%.5f",
      Adaptive_Enable?"ON":"OFF",enMult,slMult,tpMult,volMult,atr));

   if(OrdersTotal()==0)
   {
      if(dBull||(!dBull&&!dBear))
      {double eB=dH+enDist;trade.BuyStop(CalcLot(slDist),eB,_Symbol,eB-al[0],eB+tpDist,ORDER_TIME_GTC,0,"DA_BS");}
      if(dBear||(!dBull&&!dBear))
      {double eS=dL-enDist;trade.SellStop(CalcLot(slDist),eS,_Symbol,eS+al[0],eS-tpDist,ORDER_TIME_GTC,0,"DA_SS");}
   }
}
```

## PORT 5 — EA_AbyssalDiscipline_111098104.mq5 (Adaptive)

```mql5
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| EA_AbyssalDiscipline_111098104.mq5 v4.0 — Adaptive Thresholds   |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
#property copyright "Port 111098104"

input group "═══ Timeframe ═══"

// Z-Score Entry: ปรับตาม Historical Volatility ของ Spread
// ถ้า Spread volatile มาก → ต้องการ Z-Score สูงกว่าปกติ
input double Adapt_ZEntry_Base   = 2.0;  // Base Z-Score Entry
input double Adapt_ZEntry_Min    = 1.5;
input double Adapt_ZEntry_Max    = 3.0;
// Correlation Threshold: ปรับตาม Rolling Correlation

input double Adapt_Corr_Min      = -0.9;
input double Adapt_Corr_Max      = -0.5;

input double Lot_Min        = 0.01;
input double Lot_Max        = 1.0;

input group "═══ Money Management ═══"
input double MaxDD_Pct      = 8.0;
input double MaxDay_Pct     = 2.0;
input int    MaxPos         = 2;

input int Magic = 111098104;

//────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Adaptive Z-Score Entry: ปรับตาม Spread Volatility
// ถ้า Spread มีความผันผวนสูง → Z-Score ต้องสูงขึ้น (ระวังมากขึ้น)
double AdaptiveZEntry(int period, double base, double mn, double mx)
{
   double c1[], c2[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(c1, true); ArraySetAsSeries(c2, true);
   if(CopyClose(_Symbol, TF_Main, 0, period+1, c1) < period+1) return base;
   if(CopyClose(Symbol2, TF_Main, 0, period+1, c2) < period+1) return base;
   double sp[]; ArrayResize(sp, period);
   for(int i = 0; i < period; i++) sp[i] = c1[i] - (1.0 - c2[i]);
   double mn2=0,sd=0;
   for(int i=0;i<period;i++)mn2+=sp[i];mn2/=period;
   for(int i=0;i<period;i++)sd+=MathPow(sp[i]-mn2,2);sd=MathSqrt(sd/period);
   // ถ้า sd สูง = Spread volatile = ต้องการ Z-Score สูงขึ้น
   double recent_sd=0;
   int half=period/2;
   for(int i=0;i<half;i++)recent_sd+=MathPow(sp[i]-mn2,2);recent_sd=MathSqrt(recent_sd/half);
   double ratio=(sd>0)?recent_sd/sd:1.0;
   return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,base*ratio));
}

// Adaptive Correlation: เข้มงวดขึ้นถ้า Correlation อ่อนลงช่วงนี้
double AdaptiveCorrMin(int period, double base, double mn, double mx)
{
   double c1[], c2[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(c1, true); ArraySetAsSeries(c2, true);
   if(CopyClose(_Symbol, TF_Main, 0, period, c1) < period) return base;
   if(CopyClose(Symbol2, TF_Main, 0, period, c2) < period) return base;
   double m1=0,m2=0,cov=0,v1=0,v2=0;
   for(int i=0;i<period;i++){m1+=c1[i];m2+=c2[i];}m1/=period;m2/=period;
   for(int i=0;i<period;i++){cov+=(c1[i]-m1)*(c2[i]-m2);v1+=MathPow(c1[i]-m1,2);v2+=MathPow(c2[i]-m2,2);}
   double currCorr=(v1>0&&v2>0)?cov/MathSqrt(v1*v2):base;
   // ถ้า Correlation ปัจจุบันดีกว่า Base → ผ่อนผัน Threshold
   double adjustment = (currCorr < base) ? 1.05 : 0.95;
   return MathMax(mn, MathMin(mx, base * adjustment));
}

bool DDHit(){double b=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),e=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);return b>0&&(b-e)/b*100.0>=MaxDD_Pct;}
bool DayHit(){double b=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),lim=b*MaxDay_Pct/100.0;datetime d0=StringToTime(TimeToString(TimeCurrent(),TIME_DATE));double pl=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;pl+=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)+PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);}HistorySelect(d0,TimeCurrent());for(int i=0;i<HistoryDealsTotal();i++){ulong d=HistoryDealGetTicket(i);if((int)HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;if(HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_ENTRY)==DEAL_ENTRY_OUT)pl+=HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_PROFIT)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_SWAP)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_COMMISSION);}return pl<=-lim;}
void CloseAll(){for(int i=PositionsTotal()-1;i>=0;i--){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)trade.PositionClose(t);}}
int CntPos(){int n=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)n++;}return n;}

double CalcLot(){double ls=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP);double mn=MathMax(Lot_Min,SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN));double mx=MathMin(Lot_Max,SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX));if(!Lot_Dynamic){double lot=MathFloor(Lot_Fixed/ls)*ls;return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,lot));}double base=Lot_UseEquity?AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY):AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);double lot=base*Lot_RiskPct/100.0/1000.0;lot=MathFloor(lot/ls)*ls;return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,lot));}

double ZScore(){double c1[],c2[];ArraySetAsSeries(c1,true);ArraySetAsSeries(c2,true);if(CopyClose(_Symbol,TF_Main,0,Lookback+1,c1)<Lookback+1)return EMPTY_VALUE;if(CopyClose(Symbol2,TF_Main,0,Lookback+1,c2)<Lookback+1)return EMPTY_VALUE;double sp[];ArrayResize(sp,Lookback);for(int i=0;i<Lookback;i++)sp[i]=c1[i]-(1.0-c2[i]);double mn=0,sd=0;for(int i=0;i<Lookback;i++)mn+=sp[i];mn/=Lookback;for(int i=0;i<Lookback;i++)sd+=MathPow(sp[i]-mn,2);sd=MathSqrt(sd/Lookback);return sd==0?0:(sp[0]-mn)/sd;}
double Corr(){double c1[],c2[];ArraySetAsSeries(c1,true);ArraySetAsSeries(c2,true);CopyClose(_Symbol,TF_Main,0,CorrPeriod,c1);CopyClose(Symbol2,TF_Main,0,CorrPeriod,c2);double m1=0,m2=0,cov=0,v1=0,v2=0;for(int i=0;i<CorrPeriod;i++){m1+=c1[i];m2+=c2[i];}m1/=CorrPeriod;m2/=CorrPeriod;for(int i=0;i<CorrPeriod;i++){cov+=(c1[i]-m1)*(c2[i]-m2);v1+=MathPow(c1[i]-m1,2);v2+=MathPow(c2[i]-m2,2);}return(v1>0&&v2>0)?cov/MathSqrt(v1*v2):0;}

void PairExit(double zEntry, double zExit, double zSL)
{
   if(CntPos()==0)return;
   double z=ZScore();
   bool eTP=MathAbs(z)<zExit,eSL=MathAbs(z)>zSL,eDD=DDHit(),eTime=false;
   for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;if((TimeCurrent()-(datetime)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TIME))>=(datetime)(MaxHoldD*86400))eTime=true;}
   if(eTP||eSL||eTime||eDD)CloseAll();
}

int OnInit(){trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(Magic);SymbolSelect(Symbol2,true);return INIT_SUCCEEDED;}
void OnDeinit(const int r){}

void OnTick()
{
   static datetime lb=0;datetime cb=iTime(_Symbol,TF_Main,0);if(cb==lb)return;lb=cb;
   if(DDHit()){CloseAll();return;}

   //--- Adaptive Thresholds
   double zEntry,zExit,zSL,corrMin;
   if(Adaptive_Enable)
   {
      zEntry  = AdaptiveZEntry(Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_ZEntry_Base,Adapt_ZEntry_Min,Adapt_ZEntry_Max);
      corrMin = AdaptiveCorrMin(CorrPeriod,Adapt_Corr_Base,Adapt_Corr_Min,Adapt_Corr_Max);
      zExit   = Fixed_ZExit;
      zSL     = Fixed_ZHardSL * (zEntry / Fixed_ZEntry); // Scale SL ตาม Entry
   }
   else{zEntry=Fixed_ZEntry;zExit=Fixed_ZExit;zSL=Fixed_ZHardSL;corrMin=Fixed_CorrMin;}

   PairExit(zEntry, zExit, zSL);
   if(DayHit())return;
   if(CntPos()>=2)return;
   if(Corr()>corrMin)return;
   double z=ZScore();if(z==EMPTY_VALUE)return;

   Comment(StringFormat(
      "AbyssalDiscipline v4 | Adaptive: %s\n"
      "Z-Entry: %.2f | Z-Exit: %.2f | Z-SL: %.2f\n"
      "Corr Min: %.3f | Current Z: %.2f",
      Adaptive_Enable?"ON":"OFF",zEntry,zExit,zSL,corrMin,z));

   double lot=CalcLot();
   double a1=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK),b1=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID);
   double a2=SymbolInfoDouble(Symbol2,SYMBOL_ASK),b2=SymbolInfoDouble(Symbol2,SYMBOL_BID);

   if(z<-zEntry){trade.Buy(lot,_Symbol,a1,0,0,"AD_B1");trade.Sell(lot,Symbol2,b2,0,0,"AD_S2");}
   else if(z>zEntry){trade.Sell(lot,_Symbol,b1,0,0,"AD_S1");trade.Buy(lot,Symbol2,a2,0,0,"AD_B2");}
}
```

```mql5
{
   static datetime lb=0;datetime cb=iTime(_Symbol,TF_Entry,0);if(cb==lb)return;lb=cb;
   if(DDHit()){CloseAll();return;}

   if(CntPos()>=(int)MathMin(MaxPos,5))return;

   if(Adaptive_Enable)
   {
      adxMax = AdaptiveADX(hADX,Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_ADX_Mult,Adapt_ADX_Min,Adapt_ADX_Max);
      zone   = atr * AdaptiveATRMult(hATR,Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_Zone_BaseMult,Adapt_Zone_Min,Adapt_Zone_Max);
      slMult = AdaptiveATRMult(hATR,Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_SL_BaseMult,Adapt_SL_Min,Adapt_SL_Max);
      AdaptiveRSI(hRSI,Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_RSI_OS_Mult,Adapt_RSI_OB_Mult,rsiOS,rsiOB);
      AdaptiveCCI(hCCI,Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_CCI_OS_Mult,Adapt_CCI_OB_Mult,cciOS,cciOB);
   }
   else
   {
      adxMax=Fixed_ADX_Max;zone=atr*Fixed_Zone_Mult;slMult=Fixed_SL_ATR;
      rsiOS=Fixed_RSI_OS;rsiOB=Fixed_RSI_OB;cciOS=Fixed_CCI_OS;cciOB=Fixed_CCI_OB;
   }

   double adxV[2];CopyBuffer(hADX,MAIN_LINE,0,2,adxV);
   if(adxV[0]>adxMax)return;

   PV mn=CalcPV(PivotHTF,1);PV wk=CalcPV(PivotMTF,1);

   double rv[2],cv[2];CopyBuffer(hRSI,0,0,2,rv);CopyBuffer(hCCI,0,0,2,cv);
   double slDist=atr*slMult;

   bool nS1=MathAbs(px-wk.S1)<=zone,nS2=MathAbs(px-wk.S2)<=zone;
   bool nR1=MathAbs(px-wk.R1)<=zone,nR2=MathAbs(px-wk.R2)<=zone;
   bool mBull=px>mn.S1,mBear=px<mn.R1;

   Comment(StringFormat(
      "GoldenEmber v4 | Adaptive: %s\n"
      "ADX Max:%.1f | Zone:%.5f | SL Mult:%.2f\n"
      "RSI OS:%.1f OB:%.1f | CCI OS:%.1f OB:%.1f",

   }
```

```mql5
//────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Adaptive TP/SL: ปรับตาม ATR Ratio (Volatility Regime)
// ถ้า ATR ปัจจุบัน > Average = Volatile = TP/SL กว้างขึ้น
void AdaptiveTPSL(int handle,int period,
                  double baseTP,double baseSL,
                  double mnTP,double mxTP,double mnSL,double mxSL,
                  double &tp,double &sl)
{
   double buf[];ArraySetAsSeries(buf,true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle,0,0,period+1,buf)<period+1){tp=baseTP;sl=baseSL;return;}
   double cur=buf[0],sum=0;
   for(int i=1;i<=period;i++)sum+=buf[i];
   double avg=sum/period;
   double ratio=(avg>0)?cur/avg:1.0;
   tp=MathMax(mnTP,MathMin(mxTP,baseTP*ratio));
   sl=MathMax(mnSL,MathMin(mxSL,baseSL*ratio));
}

double AdaptiveVolMult(ENUM_TIMEFRAMES tf,int period,double base,double mn,double mx)
{
   long vArr[];ArraySetAsSeries(vArr,true);
   if(CopyTickVolume(_Symbol,tf,1,period*2,vArr)<period*2)return base;
   double sSum=0,lSum=0;
   for(int i=0;i<period;i++)sSum+=vArr[i];
   for(int i=period;i<period*2;i++)lSum+=vArr[i];
   double sAvg=sSum/period,lAvg=lSum/period;
   if(lAvg<=0)return base;
   return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,base/(sAvg/lAvg)));
}

{

   if(DDHit()){CloseAll();return;}
   MqlDateTime dt;TimeToStruct(TimeCurrent(),dt);

   if(today!=lastDay){trades=0;lastDay=today;}

      volMult = AdaptiveVolMult(TF_Main,Vol_Period,Adapt_Vol_BaseMult,Adapt_Vol_Min,Adapt_Vol_Max);

   long vArr[];ArraySetAsSeries(vArr,true);
   CopyTickVolume(_Symbol,TF_Main,1,Vol_Period,vArr);
   double avgV=0;for(int i=0;i<Vol_Period;i++)avgV+=vArr[i];avgV/=Vol_Period;
   bool vOK=iVolume(_Symbol,TF_Main,1)>avgV*volMult;

   double pip=GetPip();
   double sl=slPips*pip,tp=tpPips*pip;

   Comment(StringFormat(
      "TwinFlares v4 | Adaptive: %s\n"
      "TP:%.1f pips SL:%.1f pips Vol Mult:%.2f\n"
      "Trades Today:%d/%d",
      Adaptive_Enable?"ON":"OFF",tpPips,slPips,volMult,trades,MaxTrades));

   if(xUp&&vOK){double ask=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK);if(trade.Buy(CalcLot(sl),_Symbol,ask,ask-sl,ask+tp,"TF_B"))trades++;}
   else if(xDn&&vOK){double bid=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID);if(trade.Sell(CalcLot(sl),_Symbol,bid,bid+sl,bid-tp,"TF_S"))trades++;}
```

```mql5
void AdaptiveTPSL(int handle,int period,double baseTP,double baseSL,double basePC,double mnTP,double mxTP,double mnSL,double mxSL,double mnPC,double mxPC,double &tp,double &sl,double &pc)
{
   double buf[];ArraySetAsSeries(buf,true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle,0,0,period+1,buf)<period+1){tp=baseTP;sl=baseSL;pc=basePC;return;}
   double cur=buf[0],sum=0;
   for(int i=1;i<=period;i++)sum+=buf[i];
   double avg=sum/period;double ratio=(avg>0)?cur/avg:1.0;
   tp=MathMax(mnTP,MathMin(mxTP,baseTP*ratio));
   sl=MathMax(mnSL,MathMin(mxSL,baseSL*ratio));
   pc=MathMax(mnPC,MathMin(mxPC,basePC*ratio));
}

void AdaptiveRSI(int handle,int period,double mOS,double mOB,double &os,double &ob)
{
   double buf[];ArraySetAsSeries(buf,true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle,0,0,period,buf)<period){os=Fixed_RSI_OS;ob=Fixed_RSI_OB;return;}
   double sL=0,sH=0;int cL=0,cH=0;
   for(int i=0;i<period;i++){if(buf[i]<50){sL+=buf[i];cL++;}else{sH+=buf[i];cH++;}}
   os=(cL>0)?MathMax(30,MathMin(60,(sL/cL)*mOS)):Fixed_RSI_OS;
   ob=(cH>0)?MathMax(40,MathMin(70,(sH/cH)*mOB)):Fixed_RSI_OB;

void DoPC(double pcDist)
{
   if(!PC_Enable)return;
   double pip=GetPip();
   for(int i=PositionsTotal()-1;i>=0;i--)
   {ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;
    if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;
    if(StringFind(PositionGetString(POSITION_COMMENT),"_PC")>=0)continue;

    long ty=PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);
    double curP=(ty==POSITION_TYPE_BUY)?SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID):SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK);
    double profit=(ty==POSITION_TYPE_BUY)?curP-op:op-curP;
    if(profit>=pcDist)
    {double ls=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP);double mn=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN);double cl=MathFloor(vol*PC_Pct/100.0/ls)*ls;if(cl>=mn&&(vol-cl)>=mn)if(trade.PositionClosePartial(t,cl))trade.PositionModify(t,op,PositionGetDouble(POSITION_TP));}}
}

   double o1=iOpen(_Symbol,TF_Main,1),c1=iClose(_Symbol,TF_Main,1);
   double o2=iOpen(_Symbol,TF_Main,2),c2=iClose(_Symbol,TF_Main,2);

   double sl=slPips*pip,tp=tpPips*pip;

   Comment(StringFormat("BlazingArrow v4 | Adaptive: %s\nTP:%.1f SL:%.1f PC:%.1f pips\nRSI Bull>%.1f Bear<%.1f",Adaptive_Enable?"ON":"OFF",tpPips,slPips,pcPips,rsiOS,rsiOB));

   if(bull&&mBull&&bE){double ask=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK);trade.Buy(CalcLot(sl),_Symbol,ask,ask-sl,ask+tp,"BA_B");}
   else if(bear&&mBear&&sE){double bid=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID);trade.Sell(CalcLot(sl),_Symbol,bid,bid+sl,bid-tp,"BA_S");}
```

```mql5
   if(DayHit())return;if(evToday>=MaxEv)return;

   if(nT1==0)nT1=StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d %s",dt.year,dt.mon,dt.day,NewsTime1));
   if(nT2==0)nT2=StringToTime(StringFormat("%04d.%02d.%02d %s",dt.year,dt.mon,dt.day,NewsTime2));

   datetime gmt=TimeGMT();
   bool fire=(gmt>=nT1-MinBef*60&&gmt<nT1-(MinBef-1)*60)||(gmt>=nT2-MinBef*60&&gmt<nT2-(MinBef-1)*60);

   Comment(StringFormat("SolarEclipse v4 | Adaptive: %s\nEn:%.1f TP:%.1f SL:%.1f pips\nTStop:%d min SpreadMult:%.2f",Adaptive_Enable?"ON":"OFF",enPips,tpPips,slPips,tStop,spreadMult));

   if(fire&&OrdersTotal()==0&&PositionsTotal()==0)
      Straddle(enPips,tpPips,slPips,spreadMult);
}
```

## PORT 10 — EA_DragonsWrath_183977997.mq5 (Adaptive)

```mql5
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| EA_DragonsWrath_183977997.mq5 v4.0 — Adaptive Thresholds        |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
#property copyright "Port 183977997"
#property version   "4.00"
#include <Trade\Trade.mqh>
CTrade trade;

input group "═══ Timeframe ═══"
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES TF_Macro  = PERIOD_W1;
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES TF_Filter = PERIOD_D1;
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES TF_Entry  = PERIOD_H4;

input double Adapt_Trail_Min      = 1.5;
input double Adapt_Trail_Max      = 5.0;

input group "═══ FIXED FALLBACK ═══"

input double Fixed_ADX_Exit       = 20.0;
input double Fixed_SL_ATR         = 2.0;
input double Fixed_ST_Mult        = 3.0;
input double Fixed_Trail_Mult     = 3.0;

input double Lot_RiskPct    = 1.5;
input double Lot_Fixed      = 0.10;
input bool   Lot_UseEquity  = false;
input double Lot_Min        = 0.01;

input group "═══ Money Management ═══"

int hEF, hES, hADX, hATR_E, hATR_SL;

//────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
double AdaptiveADX(int handle,int period,double base,double mult,double mn,double mx)
{
   double buf[];ArraySetAsSeries(buf,true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle,MAIN_LINE,0,period,buf)<period)return base;
   double sum=0;for(int i=0;i<period;i++)sum+=buf[i];
   return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,(sum/period)*mult));
}

double AdaptiveATRMult(int handle,int period,double base,double mn,double mx)
{
   double buf[];ArraySetAsSeries(buf,true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle,0,0,period+1,buf)<period+1)return base;
   double cur=buf[0],sum=0;for(int i=1;i<=period;i++)sum+=buf[i];
   double avg=sum/period;if(avg<=0)return base;
   return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,base*(cur/avg)));
}

double GetPip(){double pt=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_POINT);int dg=(int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol,SYMBOL_DIGITS);return(dg==5||dg==3)?pt*10.0:pt;}
int CntPos(){int n=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)n++;}return n;}
bool DDHit(){double b=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),e=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);return b>0&&(b-e)/b*100.0>=MaxDD_Pct;}
bool DayHit(){double b=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),lim=b*MaxDay_Pct/100.0;datetime d0=StringToTime(TimeToString(TimeCurrent(),TIME_DATE));double pl=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;pl+=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)+PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);}HistorySelect(d0,TimeCurrent());for(int i=0;i<HistoryDealsTotal();i++){ulong d=HistoryDealGetTicket(i);if((int)HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;if(HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_ENTRY)==DEAL_ENTRY_OUT)pl+=HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_PROFIT)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_SWAP)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_COMMISSION);}return pl<=-lim;}
void CloseAll(){for(int i=PositionsTotal()-1;i>=0;i--){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)trade.PositionClose(t);}}
double CalcLot(double slDist){double ls=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP);double mn=MathMax(Lot_Min,SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN));double mx=MathMin(Lot_Max,SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX));if(!Lot_Dynamic){double lot=MathFloor(Lot_Fixed/ls)*ls;return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,lot));}double base=Lot_UseEquity?AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY):AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);double risk=base*Lot_RiskPct/100.0;double tv=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);double ts=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE);if(slDist<=0||tv<=0||ts<=0)return mn;double lot=risk/(slDist/ts*tv);lot=MathFloor(lot/ls)*ls;return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,lot));}

// Adaptive Supertrend คำนวณด้วย stMult ที่ปรับได้
int CalcST(double atr, double stMult)
{
   double hi=iHigh(_Symbol,TF_Entry,1),lo=iLow(_Symbol,TF_Entry,1);
   double c1=iClose(_Symbol,TF_Entry,1),c2=iClose(_Symbol,TF_Entry,2);
   double hl2=(hi+lo)/2.0;
   double up=hl2+stMult*atr,dn=hl2-stMult*atr;
   double fU=(pU>0&&(up<pU||c2>pU))?up:pU;
   double fL=(pL>0&&(dn>pL||c2<pL))?dn:pL;
   if(pU==0)fU=up;if(pL==0)fL=dn;
   int tr=(c1>fU)?1:(c1<fL?-1:pT);
   int sig=0;if(tr==1&&pT!=1)sig=1;if(tr==-1&&pT!=-1)sig=-1;
   pU=fU;pL=fL;pT=tr;return sig;
}

void ManageDW(double adxExit,double trailMult)
{
   double adxV[2];CopyBuffer(hADX,MAIN_LINE,0,2,adxV);
   if(adxV[0]<adxExit||DDHit()){CloseAll();return;}
   double ae[2];CopyBuffer(hATR_E,0,0,2,ae);
   double hi=iHigh(_Symbol,TF_Entry,1),lo=iLow(_Symbol,TF_Entry,1);
   double hl2=(hi+lo)/2.0;
   double tB=hl2-trailMult*ae[0],tS=hl2+trailMult*ae[0];
   for(int i=PositionsTotal()-1;i>=0;i--)
   {
      ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;
      if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;
      if(PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)<=0)continue;
      double sl=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL);long ty=PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);
      if(ty==POSITION_TYPE_BUY&&tB>sl)trade.PositionModify(t,tB,0);
      if(ty==POSITION_TYPE_SELL&&tS<sl)trade.PositionModify(t,tS,0);
   }
}

int OnInit(){hEF=iMA(_Symbol,TF_Macro,EMA_Fast,0,MODE_EMA,PRICE_CLOSE);hES=iMA(_Symbol,TF_Macro,EMA_Slow,0,MODE_EMA,PRICE_CLOSE);hADX=iADX(_Symbol,TF_Filter,ADX_Period);hATR_E=iATR(_Symbol,TF_Entry,ST_Period);hATR_SL=iATR(_Symbol,TF_Filter,ATR_SL_Per);pU=0;pL=0;pT=0;trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(Magic);return INIT_SUCCEEDED;}
void OnDeinit(const int r){IndicatorRelease(hEF);IndicatorRelease(hES);IndicatorRelease(hADX);IndicatorRelease(hATR_E);IndicatorRelease(hATR_SL);}

void OnTick()
{
   static datetime lb=0;datetime cb=iTime(_Symbol,TF_Entry,0);if(cb==lb)return;lb=cb;
   if(DDHit()){CloseAll();return;}

   //--- Adaptive Thresholds
   double adxMin,adxExit,slMult,stMult,trailMult;
   if(Adaptive_Enable)
   {
      adxMin    = AdaptiveADX(hADX,Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_ADX_Min_Base,Adapt_ADX_Min_Mult,Adapt_ADX_Min_Lo,Adapt_ADX_Min_Hi);
      adxExit   = adxMin * Adapt_ADX_Exit_Mult;
      slMult    = AdaptiveATRMult(hATR_SL,Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_SL_BaseMult,Adapt_SL_Min,Adapt_SL_Max);
      stMult    = AdaptiveATRMult(hATR_E,Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_ST_BaseMult,Adapt_ST_Min,Adapt_ST_Max);
      trailMult = AdaptiveATRMult(hATR_E,Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_Trail_BaseMult,Adapt_Trail_Min,Adapt_Trail_Max);
   }
   else{adxMin=Fixed_ADX_Min;adxExit=Fixed_ADX_Exit;slMult=Fixed_SL_ATR;stMult=Fixed_ST_Mult;trailMult=Fixed_Trail_Mult;}

   if(CntPos()>0){ManageDW(adxExit,trailMult);return;}
   if(DayHit())return;
   if(CntPos()>=(int)MathMin(MaxPos,5))return;

   double ef[2],es[2];CopyBuffer(hEF,0,0,2,ef);CopyBuffer(hES,0,0,2,es);
   bool hBull=ef[0]>es[0],hBear=ef[0]<es[0];
   double adxV[2];CopyBuffer(hADX,MAIN_LINE,0,2,adxV);
   if(adxV[0]<adxMin)return;

   double ae[3];CopyBuffer(hATR_E,0,0,3,ae);
   int sig=CalcST(ae[1],stMult);
   double as2[2];CopyBuffer(hATR_SL,0,0,2,as2);
   double slDist=as2[0]*slMult;

   Comment(StringFormat("DragonsWrath v4 | Adaptive: %s\nADX Min:%.1f Exit:%.1f\nSL Mult:%.2f ST Mult:%.2f Trail:%.2f",Adaptive_Enable?"ON":"OFF",adxMin,adxExit,slMult,stMult,trailMult));

   if(hBull&&sig==1){double ask=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK);trade.Buy(CalcLot(slDist),_Symbol,ask,ask-slDist,0,"DW_B");}
   else if(hBear&&sig==-1){double bid=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID);trade.Sell(CalcLot(slDist),_Symbol,bid,bid+slDist,0,"DW_S");}
}
```

```mql5
void AdaptiveTPSL(int handle,int period,double baseTP,double baseSL,double mnTP,double mxTP,double mnSL,double mxSL,double &tp,double &sl)
{
   double buf[];ArraySetAsSeries(buf,true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle,0,0,period+1,buf)<period+1){tp=baseTP;sl=baseSL;return;}
   double cur=buf[0],sum=0;for(int i=1;i<=period;i++)sum+=buf[i];
   double avg=sum/period;double ratio=(avg>0)?cur/avg:1.0;
   tp=MathMax(mnTP,MathMin(mxTP,baseTP*ratio));
   sl=MathMax(mnSL,MathMin(mxSL,baseSL*ratio));
}

void AdaptiveRSI(int handle,int period,double mOS,double mOB,double loOS,double hiOS,double loOB,double hiOB,double &rsiBull,double &rsiBear)

   double sum=0;for(int i=0;i<period;i++)sum+=buf[i];double avg=sum/period;
   rsiBull=MathMax(loOS,MathMin(hiOS,avg*mOS));
   rsiBear=MathMax(loOB,MathMin(hiOB,avg*mOB));
}

   double pip=GetPip();

   if(tBull&&xUp){double ask=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK);trade.Buy(CalcLot(sl),_Symbol,ask,ask-sl,ask+tp,"ES_B");}
   else if(tBear&&xDn){double bid=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID);trade.Sell(CalcLot(sl),_Symbol,bid,bid+sl,bid-tp,"ES_S");}
```

## สรุป Adaptive Functions ที่เพิ่มในแต่ละ EA

| EA | Adaptive ที่เพิ่ม |
|---|---|
| **Port 1** Celestial | ADX Threshold + SL/TP ATR Multiplier |
| **Port 2** Ironclad | ADX + RSI OS/OB + BB Width + Grid Distance + Basket TP/SL |
| **Port 3** Dawn | Entry Distance + SL/TP + Volume Multiplier |
| **Port 4** Crimson | ADX + RSI + Stochastic + BB Width + SL Multiplier |
| **Port 5** Abyssal | Z-Score Entry + Correlation Threshold |
| **Port 6** Golden | ADX + Zone Size + RSI + CCI + SL Multiplier |
| **Port 7** Twin | TP/SL Pips + Volume Multiplier |
| **Port 8** Blazing | TP/SL/PC Pips + RSI Bull/Bear Level |
| **Port 9** Solar | Entry/TP/SL/Time Stop/Spread Multiplier ทั้งหมด |
| **Port 10** Dragon | ADX Min/Exit + SL/ST/Trail Multiplier |
| **Port 11** Ember | TP/SL Pips + RSI Bull/Bear Level |

### หลักการ Adaptive แต่ละประเภท

```
1. Adaptive ADX   = AvgADX(N bars) × Multiplier
   → ตลาด Trend แรงช่วงนี้ → Threshold สูงขึ้น

2. Adaptive ATR   = CurrentATR / AvgATR(N) × BaseMult
   → Volatile สูง → SL/TP/Entry กว้างขึ้น

3. Adaptive RSI   = Avg(RSI Lower Bars) × OsMult
   → ตลาดที่ Oversold บ่อย → OS Level ปรับลง

4. Adaptive Vol   = AvgVol(Short) / AvgVol(Long)
   → Session Active มาก → Threshold ต่ำลง (เข้าง่ายขึ้น)

5. Adaptive Z     = SpreadSD(Recent) / SpreadSD(All)
   → Spread Volatile มาก → Z-Score ต้องสูงขึ้น
```

> **เปิด Adaptive ด้วย** `Adaptive_Enable = true` และตั้งค่า `Adapt_Lookback` ตามต้องการครับบอส ถ้าต้องการทดสอบแบบ Fixed ก่อนให้ตั้ง `Adaptive_Enable = false` 🔥

----- [user] -----
เพิ่มอีกหน่อยสิ ที่เกี่ยวกับ ATR ทุกตัวปรับ Timeframe ให้ได้ด้วย

----- [assistant] -----
ครับบอส — เพิ่ม ATR Multi-Timeframe ให้ทุก EA เลย โดยให้เลือก TF ของ ATR ได้อิสระ พร้อมเพิ่ม ATR Regime Detection ด้วย

---

## PORT 1 — EA_CelestialWoodfire_141049900.mq5

```mql5
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
//| EA_CelestialWoodfire_141049900.mq5                               |
//| v5.0 — ATR Multi-Timeframe + Adaptive Thresholds                |
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
#property copyright "Port 141049900"
#property version   "5.00"
#include <Trade\Trade.mqh>
CTrade trade;

input group "═══ Timeframe ═══"
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES TF_Trend   = PERIOD_D1;
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES TF_Confirm = PERIOD_H4;
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES TF_Entry   = PERIOD_H1;

input group "═══ ATR TIMEFRAME SETTINGS ═══"
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES ATR_TF_SL       = PERIOD_H4;  // TF สำหรับคำนวณ SL
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES ATR_TF_TP       = PERIOD_D1;  // TF สำหรับคำนวณ TP
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES ATR_TF_Trail    = PERIOD_H4;  // TF สำหรับ Trailing Stop
input ENUM_TIMEFRAMES ATR_TF_Regime   = PERIOD_W1;  // TF สำหรับ Volatility Regime
input int    ATR_Period               = 14;
input int    ATR_Regime_Lookback      = 20;          // ดูย้อนหลัง N แท่งสำหรับ Regime

input group "═══ Indicator ═══"
input int    EMA_Fast   = 50;
input int    EMA_Slow   = 200;
input int    MACD_Fast  = 12;
input int    MACD_Slow  = 26;
input int    MACD_Sig   = 9;
input int    ADX_Period = 14;

input group "═══ ADAPTIVE THRESHOLDS ═══"
input bool   Adaptive_Enable    = true;
input int    Adapt_Lookback     = 50;
input double Adapt_ADX_Mult     = 0.9;
input double Adapt_ADX_Min      = 18.0;
input double Adapt_ADX_Max      = 40.0;
input double Adapt_SL_BaseMult  = 1.5;
input double Adapt_TP_BaseMult  = 3.0;
input double Adapt_SL_Min       = 0.8;
input double Adapt_SL_Max       = 3.0;
input double Adapt_TP_Min       = 1.5;
input double Adapt_TP_Max       = 6.0;

input group "═══ FIXED FALLBACK ═══"
input double Fixed_ADX_Min      = 25.0;
input double Fixed_SL_ATR       = 1.5;
input double Fixed_TP_ATR       = 3.0;
input double Fixed_Trail_ATR    = 1.0;

input group "═══ LOT MODE ═══"
input bool   Lot_Dynamic    = true;
input double Lot_RiskPct    = 1.0;
input double Lot_Fixed      = 0.10;
input bool   Lot_UseEquity  = false;
input double Lot_Min        = 0.01;
input double Lot_Max        = 5.0;

input group "═══ Trailing ═══"
input bool   UseTrail       = true;

input group "═══ Money Management ═══"
input double MaxDD_Pct      = 10.0;
input double MaxDay_Pct     = 3.0;
input int    MaxPos         = 2;
input int    Magic          = 141049900;

//--- Handles
int hEF_T, hES_T, hEF_C, hES_C, hMACD, hADX;
int hATR_SL, hATR_TP, hATR_Trail, hATR_Regime;

//────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//  ATR REGIME DETECTION
//  คืนค่า Ratio = CurrentATR / AvgATR
//  > 1.0 = Volatile (ATR สูงกว่าปกติ)
//  < 1.0 = Quiet    (ATR ต่ำกว่าปกติ)
//────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
double GetATRRegime()
{
   double buf[];
   ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(hATR_Regime, 0, 0, ATR_Regime_Lookback+1, buf) < ATR_Regime_Lookback+1)
      return 1.0;
   double cur = buf[0], sum = 0;
   for(int i = 1; i <= ATR_Regime_Lookback; i++) sum += buf[i];
   double avg = sum / ATR_Regime_Lookback;
   return (avg > 0) ? cur / avg : 1.0;
}

//--- ดึง ATR จาก TF ที่กำหนด
double GetATR(int handle)
{
   double buf[2];
   ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle, 0, 0, 2, buf) < 2) return 0;
   return buf[0];
}

//────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
double AdaptiveADX(int handle, int period, double mult, double mn, double mx)
{
   double buf[]; ArraySetAsSeries(buf, true);
   if(CopyBuffer(handle, MAIN_LINE, 0, period, buf) < period) return mn;
   double sum = 0;
   for(int i = 0; i < period; i++) sum += buf[i];
   return MathMax(mn, MathMin(mx, (sum/period)*mult));
}

double AdaptiveMult(double base, double regime, double mn, double mx)
{
   return MathMax(mn, MathMin(mx, base * regime));
}

//────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
double GetPip(){double pt=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_POINT);int dg=(int)SymbolInfoInteger(_Symbol,SYMBOL_DIGITS);return(dg==5||dg==3)?pt*10.0:pt;}
int CntPos(){int n=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)n++;}return n;}
bool DDHit(){double b=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),e=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY);return b>0&&(b-e)/b*100.0>=MaxDD_Pct;}
bool DayHit(){double b=AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE),lim=b*MaxDay_Pct/100.0;datetime d0=StringToTime(TimeToString(TimeCurrent(),TIME_DATE));double pl=0;for(int i=0;i<PositionsTotal();i++){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;pl+=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)+PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SWAP);}HistorySelect(d0,TimeCurrent());for(int i=0;i<HistoryDealsTotal();i++){ulong d=HistoryDealGetTicket(i);if((int)HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;if(HistoryDealGetInteger(d,DEAL_ENTRY)==DEAL_ENTRY_OUT)pl+=HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_PROFIT)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_SWAP)+HistoryDealGetDouble(d,DEAL_COMMISSION);}return pl<=-lim;}
void CloseAll(){for(int i=PositionsTotal()-1;i>=0;i--){ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(PositionSelectByTicket(t)&&(int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)==Magic)trade.PositionClose(t);}}

double CalcLot(double slDist)
{
   double ls=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_STEP);
   double mn=MathMax(Lot_Min,SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN));
   double mx=MathMin(Lot_Max,SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX));
   if(!Lot_Dynamic){double lot=MathFloor(Lot_Fixed/ls)*ls;return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,lot));}
   double base=Lot_UseEquity?AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_EQUITY):AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_BALANCE);
   double risk=base*Lot_RiskPct/100.0;
   double tv=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_VALUE);
   double ts=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_TRADE_TICK_SIZE);
   if(slDist<=0||tv<=0||ts<=0)return mn;
   double lot=risk/(slDist/ts*tv);
   lot=MathFloor(lot/ls)*ls;
   return MathMax(mn,MathMin(mx,lot));
}

void DoTrail(double trailDist)
{
   double ef[2]; CopyBuffer(hEF_C, 0, 0, 2, ef);
   for(int i=PositionsTotal()-1;i>=0;i--)
   {
      ulong t=PositionGetTicket(i);if(!PositionSelectByTicket(t))continue;
      if((int)PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)!=Magic)continue;
      if(PositionGetDouble(POSITION_PROFIT)<=0)continue;
      double sl=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_SL),tp=PositionGetDouble(POSITION_TP);
      long ty=PositionGetInteger(POSITION_TYPE);
      if(ty==POSITION_TYPE_BUY){double n=ef[0]-trailDist;if(n>sl&&n<SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID))trade.PositionModify(t,n,tp);}
      else{double n=ef[0]+trailDist;if(n<sl&&n>SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK))trade.PositionModify(t,n,tp);}
   }
}

int OnInit()
{
   hEF_T       = iMA(_Symbol,TF_Trend,EMA_Fast,0,MODE_EMA,PRICE_CLOSE);
   hES_T       = iMA(_Symbol,TF_Trend,EMA_Slow,0,MODE_EMA,PRICE_CLOSE);
   hEF_C       = iMA(_Symbol,TF_Confirm,EMA_Fast,0,MODE_EMA,PRICE_CLOSE);
   hES_C       = iMA(_Symbol,TF_Confirm,EMA_Slow,0,MODE_EMA,PRICE_CLOSE);
   hMACD       = iMACD(_Symbol,TF_Entry,MACD_Fast,MACD_Slow,MACD_Sig,PRICE_CLOSE);
   hADX        = iADX(_Symbol,TF_Entry,ADX_Period);
   hATR_SL     = iATR(_Symbol,ATR_TF_SL,    ATR_Period);
   hATR_TP     = iATR(_Symbol,ATR_TF_TP,    ATR_Period);
   hATR_Trail  = iATR(_Symbol,ATR_TF_Trail, ATR_Period);
   hATR_Regime = iATR(_Symbol,ATR_TF_Regime,ATR_Period);
   trade.SetExpertMagicNumber(Magic);
   Print("CW v5 | ATR_SL:",EnumToString(ATR_TF_SL),
         " ATR_TP:",EnumToString(ATR_TF_TP),
         " Trail:",EnumToString(ATR_TF_Trail),
         " Regime:",EnumToString(ATR_TF_Regime));
   return INIT_SUCCEEDED;
}

void OnDeinit(const int r)
{
   IndicatorRelease(hEF_T);IndicatorRelease(hES_T);
   IndicatorRelease(hEF_C);IndicatorRelease(hES_C);
   IndicatorRelease(hMACD);IndicatorRelease(hADX);
   IndicatorRelease(hATR_SL);IndicatorRelease(hATR_TP);
   IndicatorRelease(hATR_Trail);IndicatorRelease(hATR_Regime);
}

void OnTick()
{
   static datetime lb=0;
   datetime cb=iTime(_Symbol,TF_Entry,0);
   if(cb==lb)return;lb=cb;
   if(DDHit()){CloseAll();return;}

   //--- ATR แยกตาม TF
   double atr_sl    = GetATR(hATR_SL);
   double atr_tp    = GetATR(hATR_TP);
   double atr_trail = GetATR(hATR_Trail);
   double regime    = GetATRRegime();  // Volatile Ratio จาก W1

   //--- Adaptive Thresholds ปรับด้วย Regime
   double adxThresh, slMult, tpMult, trailMult;
   if(Adaptive_Enable)
   {
      adxThresh  = AdaptiveADX(hADX,Adapt_Lookback,Adapt_ADX_Mult,Adapt_ADX_Min,Adapt_ADX_Max);
      slMult     = AdaptiveMult(Adapt_SL_BaseMult, regime, Adapt_SL_Min, Adapt_SL_Max);
      tpMult     = AdaptiveMult(Adapt_TP_BaseMult, regime, Adapt_TP_Min, Adapt_TP_Max);
      trailMult  = AdaptiveMult(Fixed_Trail_ATR,   regime, 0.5, 3.0);
   }
   else
   { adxThresh=Fixed_ADX_Min; slMult=Fixed_SL_ATR; tpMult=Fixed_TP_ATR; trailMult=Fixed_Trail_ATR; }

   double slDist    = atr_sl    * slMult;
   double tpDist    = atr_tp    * tpMult;
   double trailDist = atr_trail * trailMult;

   Comment(StringFormat(
      "CelestialWoodfire v5\n"
      "Regime: %.2f | ADX Thresh: %.1f\n"
      "SL ATR(%s)×%.2f = %.5f\n"
      "TP ATR(%s)×%.2f = %.5f\n"
      "Trail ATR(%s)×%.2f = %.5f",
      regime, adxThresh,
      EnumToString(ATR_TF_SL),   slMult,    slDist,
      EnumToString(ATR_TF_TP),   tpMult,    tpDist,
      EnumToString(ATR_TF_Trail),trailMult, trailDist));

   if(UseTrail) DoTrail(trailDist);
   if(DayHit()) return;
   if(CntPos()>=(int)MathMin(MaxPos,5)) return;

   double eft[2],est[2],efc[2],esc[2];
   CopyBuffer(hEF_T,0,0,2,eft);CopyBuffer(hES_T,0,0,2,est);
   CopyBuffer(hEF_C,0,0,2,efc);CopyBuffer(hES_C,0,0,2,esc);
   bool tBull=eft[0]>est[0],tBear=eft[0]<est[0];
   bool cBull=efc[0]>esc[0],cBear=efc[0]<esc[0];

   double mm[3],ms[3],adx[2];
   CopyBuffer(hMACD,MAIN_LINE,0,3,mm);CopyBuffer(hMACD,SIGNAL_LINE,0,3,ms);
   CopyBuffer(hADX,MAIN_LINE,0,2,adx);
   bool mUp=mm[1]>ms[1]&&mm[2]<=ms[2];
   bool mDn=mm[1]<ms[1]&&mm[2]>=ms[2];

   if(tBull&&cBull&&mUp&&adx[0]>adxThresh)
   {double ask=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_ASK);trade.Buy(CalcLot(slDist),_Symbol,ask,ask-slDist,ask+tpDist,"CW_B");}
   else if(tBear&&cBear&&mDn&&adx[0]>adxThresh)
   {double bid=SymbolInfoDouble(_Symbol,SYMBOL_BID);trade.Sell(CalcLot(slDist),_Symbol,bid,bid+slDist,bid-tpDist,"CW_S");}
}
```

---

> บอส — Port 1 เสร็จครบแล้ว Pattern เดียวกันนี้จะใช้ซ้ำทุก EA ครับ ผมจะสรุป **โครงสร้างส่วน ATR** ที่เพิ่มในแต่ละตัว แล้วเขียน Port 2-11 ต่อเลย
